Links: [{"title":"Rate limits","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/rate-limits"},{"title":"Record usage for billing","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based-legacy/recording-usage"},{"title":"Stripe APIs","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/apis"},{"title":"Search","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/search"},{"title":"Access Stripe data with the API","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/data/api"},{"title":"https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usag...","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based/recording-usage-api.md"},{"title":"Embeddable pricing table for subscriptions","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/pricing-table"},{"title":"Error handling","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/error-handling?locale=en-GB"},{"title":"Removes the rate limit parameter from the Batch Job v2 object","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia/2026-06-24/batch-job-v2-remove-rate-limit-parameter"},{"title":"Make API calls for connected accounts","url":"https://docs.stripe.com/connect/authentication"}]

The main Stripe rate limits page is at docs.stripe.com/rate-limits. It covers global and per-endpoint request limits, concurrency limits, 429 handling, and read-request allocations.

- **Global and endpoint limits:** Rate limits are generally measured in API requests per second, per Stripe account. Live mode has a global limit of 100 requests per second, sandbox has 25, and most individual endpoints have 25 per second.
- **Concurrency:** Separately, the default global concurrency limit for standard API traffic in live mode is 50 in-progress requests.
- **Rate-limited responses:** Throttled requests return HTTP 429 with a Stripe-Rate-Limited-Reason header that explains why the request was rate-limited.
- **Handling:** Stripe recommends retrying with exponential backoff and added randomness, and client-side token bucket throttling.
- **Read allocations:** Read requests are capped at an average of 500 per transaction, and every account gets a minimum of 10,000 read requests per month.

Endpoint-specific limits differ from the global one:
- **Search API:** Up to 20 read operations per second for all search endpoints in live mode and test environments.
- **Meter Events:** 1000 calls per second per Stripe account in live mode, and these calls don't count against the global limit.
- **Embeddable pricing table:** Up to 50 read operations per second.

One result is out of date. A legacy usage-recording page, roughly 936 days old, still cites a 100-calls-per-second figure for usage reporting, so the current rate-limits page is the better reference.
